specs.Compatible Devices: Laptops, Smartphones, Gaming Consoles, Media Players, Blu-ray Players

features: NATIVE FULL HD 1080P WITH 4K SUPPORT Experience sharp and detailed visuals with Native 1920 x 1080 Full HD resolution and 4K video support. Ideal for office presentations, classroom teaching, training sessions, movies, and educational content on screens up to 210 inches.

WIRED PROJECTOR FOR STABLE PERFORMANCE Designed as a wired non-smart projector with no WiFi, no built-in apps, and no mobile mirroring. Connect laptops, PCs, set-top boxes, Fire TV Stick devices, gaming consoles, and media players through HDMI for reliable and uninterrupted playback

BRIGHT 6000 LUMENS FOR OFFICE & CLASSROOM USE High-brightness 6000-lumen LED light source combined with a 3000:1 contrast ratio delivers clear images and readable text, making it suitable for classrooms, conference rooms, training centers, and indoor presentations.

MULTIPLE CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS Equipped with Dual HDMI ports, USB, AV input, Micro SD card support, and Audio Out for seamless connection to laptops, desktops, streaming devices, gaming consoles, speakers, and external media sources.

BLUETOOTH 5.3 AUDIO & 50,000-HOUR LAMP LIFE Wirelessly connect compatible Bluetooth speakers, soundbars, and headphones for enhanced sound. The long-lasting LED lamp offers up to 50,000 hours of usage for dependable long-term performance.

IDEAL FOR OFFICE, CLASSROOM & HOME VIEWING Perfect for presentations, training programs, coaching institutes, educational content, conference rooms, movie nights, and large-screen entertainment with a projection size of up to 210 inches.
